text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: VISUAL IDENTITY PROGRAM

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: Guidelines on the Use of Symbols

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: To identify ministries, departments, divisions, and other

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: organizations of the government of British Columbia, one of three

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: symbols shall be used.

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: 1. Coat of Arms

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: Generally, the formal Coat of Arms of the Province of British

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: Columbia is used to identify the Legislature, the Office of

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: the Lieutenant-Governor and Government House, and the

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: judiciary.

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: Other organizations wishing to use the formal Coat of Arms are

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: required to obtain written authorization from the office of

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: the Deputy Minister, Information Programs, who will consult

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: with the protocol office of the Ministry of the Provincial

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: Secretary as required.

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: 2. Stylized Coat of Arms

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: The Stylized Coat of Arms surrounded by a border ("provincial

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: symbol") shall be used to identify all provincial government

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: ministries, departments, divisions, and activities.

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: The

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: symbol must be accompanied by the words Province of British

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: Columbia, as specified in the visual identity program manual.

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: The further identification of a ministry and minister is

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: normal practice.

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: The addition of a department of division is

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: permitted where necessary.

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Province of

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: British Columbia
